verdict.rationale: Missive's own homepage says teams can "collaborate behind the scenes" on shared inbox work, and a community user says they prefer Missive because they can "collaborate directly in a thread." That points to internal discussion on email conversations. But no evidence explicitly documents comments placed beside a message or @mentions, and the team chat feature is separate group chat rather than a side-thread on an email. Missing for 10: explicit docs for internal comments attached to an email conversation, @mention notifications, and hands-on corroboration that this replaces forwarding.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: See what’s going on, know who’s doing what, and collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow.
they want to collaborate directly in a thread, as Missive's collaborative writing allows
